defined_path_qualification: Every consumed local float must have been written by CalcEmitter or a real prior loop iteration. Genuine uninitialized locals remain; possible unsafe paths and unknown global producer invariant are explicit. Tests track write/consumption validity rather than invent outputs.
stop: Actual void caller and ten canonical callee ABIs; finite/domain and alias evidence; no invented defaults or universal runtime-safety claim. T050-gated CalcEmitter stays read-only. Natural C89/O2/O1, exact ELF extent and bounded diagnosis; strict body equality remains separate from semantic safety outside the declared domain.
